name: Nexora Star Scholarship
criteria: Top 5% of applicants in the Nexora Aptitude Test.
coverage: 40% off per-credit-hour tuition for the first two semesters.
conditions: Full-time enrolment; 3.4 CGPA to keep it for the second semester.

name: First-Generation Learner Grant
criteria: Neither parent holds a university degree; family income documents required.
conditions: Assessed by interview; reviewed each year.

name: Sports Excellence Award
criteria: Represented a province or country at a recognised sports event.
conditions: Must join a university team; certificate required.
